segments.mnd10:3.2: Kathaṃdassīti kīdisena dassanena samannāgato, kiṃsaṇṭhitena, kiṃpakārena, kiṃpaṭibhāgenāti –
segments.mnd10:3.4: Kathaṃsīloti kīdisena sīlena samannāgato, kiṃsaṇṭhitena, kiṃpakārena, kiṃpaṭibhāgenāti –
segments.mnd10:3.6: Upasantoti vuccatīti santo upasanto vūpasanto nibbuto paṭipassaddhoti vuccati pavuccati kathīyati bhaṇīyati dīpīyati voharīyati.
segments.mnd10:3.7: Kathaṃdassīti adhipaññaṃ pucchati, kathaṃsīloti adhisīlaṃ pucchati, upasantoti adhicittaṃ pucchatīti –
segments.mnd10:4.2: Tanti yaṃ pucchāmi, yaṃ yācāmi, yaṃ ajjhesāmi, yaṃ pasādemi.
segments.mnd10:4.3: Gotamāti so nimmito buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ gottena ālapati.
segments.mnd10:4.4: Pabrūhīti brūhi ācikkha desehi paññapehi paṭṭhapehi vivara vibhaja uttānīkarohi pakāsehīti –
segments.mnd10:5.3: Uttamaṃ naranti aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ visiṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaraṃ naranti –
segments.mnd10:9.2: Purā kāyassa bhedā, purā attabhāvassa bhedā, purā kaḷevarassa nikkhepā, purā jīvitindriyassa upacchedā vītataṇho vigatataṇho cattataṇho vantataṇho muttataṇho pahīnataṇho paṭinissaṭṭhataṇho, vītarāgo vigatarāgo cattarāgo vantarāgo muttarāgo pahīnarāgo paṭinissaṭṭharāgo, nicchāto nibbuto sītibhūto sukhappaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
segments.mnd10:10.12: bhaji vā bhagavā araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppānīti bhagavā,
segments.mnd10:10.14: bhāgī vā bhagavā attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa adhisīlassa adhicittassa adhipaññāyāti bhagavā,
segments.mnd10:10.15: bhāgī vā bhagavā catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ catunnaṃ appamaññānaṃ catunnaṃ arūpasamāpattīnanti bhagavā,
segments.mnd10:10.16: bhāgī vā bhagavā aṭṭhannaṃ vimokkhānaṃ aṭṭhannaṃ abhibhāyatanānaṃ navannaṃ anupubbavihārasamāpattīnanti bhagavā,
segments.mnd10:10.17: bhāgī vā bhagavā dasannaṃ paññābhāvanānaṃ dasannaṃ kasiṇasamāpattīnaṃ ānāpānassatisamādhissa asubhasamāpattiyāti bhagavā,
segments.mnd10:10.18: bhāgī vā bhagavā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ pañcannaṃ balānaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassāti bhagavā,
segments.mnd10:10.19: bhāgī vā bhagavā dasannaṃ tathāgatabalānaṃ catunnaṃ vesārajjānaṃ catunnaṃ paṭisambhidānaṃ channaṃ abhiññānaṃ channaṃ buddhadhammānanti bhagavā.
segments.mnd10:10.20: Bhagavāti netaṃ nāmaṃ mātarā kataṃ, na pitarā kataṃ, na bhātarā kataṃ, na bhaginiyā kataṃ, na mittāmaccehi kataṃ, na ñātisālohitehi kataṃ, na samaṇabrāhmaṇehi kataṃ, na devatāhi kataṃ;
segments.mnd10:10.21: vimokkhantikametaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutañāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikā paññatti yadidaṃ bhagavāti –
segments.mnd10:11.2: Atītaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha taṇhā pahīnā, diṭṭhi paṭinissaṭṭhā taṇhāya pahīnattā, diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaṭṭhattā.
segments.mnd10:11.4: Atha vā “evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānan”ti tattha nandiṃ na samannāneti,
segments.mnd10:11.8: evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānan”ti tattha nandiṃ na samannāneti.
segments.mnd10:11.10: Atha vā “iti me cakkhu [cakkhuṃ (sī. ka.)] ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:11.11: iti rūpā”ti tattha na chandarāgapaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, na chandarāgapaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa na tadabhinandati;
segments.mnd10:11.15: iti saddā”ti,“iti me ghānaṃ ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:11.16: iti gandhā”ti,“iti me jivhā ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:11.17: iti rasā”ti,“iti me kāyo ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:11.18: iti phoṭṭhabbā”ti,“iti me mano ahosi atītamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:11.19: iti dhammā”ti tattha na chandarāgapaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, na chandarāgapaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa na tadabhinandati;
segments.mnd10:11.22: Atha vā yāni tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni na tadassādeti, na taṃ nikāmeti, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
segments.mnd10:12.3: Paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha taṇhā pahīnā, diṭṭhi paṭinissaṭṭhā.
segments.mnd10:12.4: Taṇhāya pahīnattā, diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaṭṭhattā rattoti nupasaṅkheyyo, duṭṭhoti nupasaṅkheyyo, mūḷhoti nupasaṅkheyyo, vinibaddhoti nupasaṅkheyyo, parāmaṭṭhoti nupasaṅkheyyo, vikkhepagatoti nupasaṅkheyyo, aniṭṭhaṅgatoti nupasaṅkheyyo, thāmagatoti nupasaṅkheyyo;
segments.mnd10:12.6: abhisaṅkhārānaṃ pahīnattā gatiyā nupasaṅkheyyo, nerayikoti vā tiracchānayonikoti vā pettivisayikoti vā manussoti vā devoti vā rūpīti vā arūpīti vā saññīti vā asaññīti vā nevasaññīnāsaññīti vā.
segments.mnd10:12.7: So hetu natthi paccayo natthi kāraṇaṃ natthi yena saṅkhaṃ gaccheyyāti –
segments.mnd10:13.8: Taṇhāpurekkhārassa pahīnattā, diṭṭhipurekkhārassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā na taṇhaṃ vā diṭṭhiṃ vā purato katvā carati, na taṇhādhajo na taṇhāketu na taṇhādhipateyyo, na diṭṭhidhajo na diṭṭhiketu na diṭṭhādhipateyyo, na taṇhāya vā diṭṭhiyā vā parivārito carati.
segments.mnd10:13.10: Atha vā “evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānan”ti tattha nandiṃ na samannāneti,
segments.mnd10:13.14: evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānan”ti tattha nandiṃ na samannāneti.
segments.mnd10:13.16: Atha vā “iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:13.17: iti rūpā”ti appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ na paṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānappaccayā na tadabhinandati;
segments.mnd10:13.21: iti saddā”ti,“iti me ghānaṃ siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:13.22: iti gandhā”ti,“iti me jivhā siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:13.23: iti rasā”ti,“iti me kāyo siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:13.24: iti phoṭṭhabbā”ti,“iti me mano siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:13.25: iti dhammā”ti appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ na paṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānappaccayā na tadabhinandati;
segments.mnd10:13.28: Atha vā “imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro”ti vā appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ na paṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānappaccayā na tadabhinandati;
segments.mnd10:17.15: Yo evarūpo cittassa āghāto paṭighāto, paṭighaṃ paṭivirodho, kopo pakopo sampakopo, doso padoso sampadoso, cittassa byāpatti manopadoso, kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ, doso dussanā dussitattaṃ, byāpatti byāpajjanā byāpajjitattaṃ, virodho paṭivirodho caṇḍikkaṃ, asuropo [assuropo (sī. ka.)] anattamanatā cittassa –
segments.mnd10:18.2: Atthi kañci [kiñci (ka.)] kālaṃ kodho cittāvilakaraṇamatto hoti, na ca tāva mukhakulānavikulāno hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.3: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho mukhakulānavikulānamatto hoti, na ca tāva hanusañcopano hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.4: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho hanusañcopanamatto hoti, na ca tāva pharusavācaṃ nicchāraṇo [pharusavācanicchāraṇo (syā.)] hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.5: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho pharusavācaṃ nicchāraṇamatto hoti, na ca tāva disāvidisānuvilokano hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.6: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho disāvidisānuvilokanamatto hoti, na ca tāva daṇḍasatthaparāmasano hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.7: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho daṇḍasatthaparāmasanamatto hoti, na ca tāva daṇḍasatthaabbhukkiraṇo hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.8: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho daṇḍasatthaabbhukkiraṇamatto hoti, na ca tāva daṇḍasatthaabhinipātano hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.9: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho daṇḍasatthaabhinipātamatto hoti, na ca tāva chinnavicchinnakaraṇo hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.10: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho chinnavicchinnakaraṇamatto hoti, na ca tāva sambhañjanapalibhañjano hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.11: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho sambhañjanapalibhañjanamatto hoti, na ca tāva aṅgamaṅgaapakaḍḍhano hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.12: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho aṅgamaṅgaapakaḍḍhanamatto hoti, na ca tāva jīvitāvoropano [jīvitapanāsano (syā.)] hoti;
segments.mnd10:18.13: atthi kañci kālaṃ kodho jīvitāvoropanamatto hoti, na ca tāva sabbacāgapariccāgāya saṇṭhito hoti.
segments.mnd10:18.14: Yato kodho parapuggalaṃ ghāṭetvā attānaṃ ghāṭeti, ettāvatā kodho paramussadagato paramavepullappatto hoti.
segments.mnd10:18.15: Yassa so kodho pahīno samucchinno vūpasanto paṭipassaddho abhabbuppattiko ñāṇagginā daḍḍho, so vuccati akkodhano.
segments.mnd10:18.16: Kodhassa pahīnattā akkodhano, kodhavatthussa pariññātattā akkodhano, kodhahetussa upacchinnattā akkodhanoti –
segments.mnd10:19.1: Asantāsīti idhekacco tāsī hoti uttāsī parittāsī, so tasati na uttasati parittasati bhāyati santāsaṃ āpajjati.
segments.mnd10:19.2: Kulaṃ vā na labhāmi, gaṇaṃ vā na labhāmi, āvāsaṃ vā na labhāmi, lābhaṃ vā na labhāmi, yasaṃ vā na labhāmi, pasaṃsaṃ vā na labhāmi, sukhaṃ vā na labhāmi, cīvaraṃ vā na labhāmi, piṇḍapātaṃ vā na labhāmi, senāsanaṃ vā na labhāmi, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ vā na labhāmi, gilānupaṭṭhākaṃ vā na labhāmi, appaññātomhīti tasati uttasati parittasati bhāyati santāsaṃ āpajjati.
segments.mnd10:20.1: Idha bhikkhu asantāsī hoti anuttāsī aparittāsī;
segments.mnd10:20.2: so na tasati na uttasati na parittasati na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjati.
segments.mnd10:20.3: Kulaṃ vā na labhāmi, gaṇaṃ vā na labhāmi, āvāsaṃ vā na labhāmi, lābhaṃ vā na labhāmi, yasaṃ vā na labhāmi, pasaṃsaṃ vā na labhāmi, sukhaṃ vā na labhāmi, cīvaraṃ vā na labhāmi, piṇḍapātaṃ vā na labhāmi, senāsanaṃ vā na labhāmi, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ vā na labhāmi, gilānupaṭṭhākaṃ vā na labhāmi, appaññātomhīti na tasati na uttasati na parittasati na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjatīti –
segments.mnd10:21.2: Idhekacco katthī hoti vikatthī, so katthati vikatthati –
segments.mnd10:21.3: ahamasmi sīlasampannoti vā vatasampannoti vā sīlabbatasampannoti vā
segments.mnd10:21.4: jātiyā vā gottena vā kolaputtiyena vā vaṇṇapokkharatāya vā dhanena vā ajjhenena vā kammāyatanena vā sippāyatanena vā vijjāṭṭhānena vā sutena vā paṭibhānena vā aññataraññatarena vā vatthunā.
segments.mnd10:21.5: Uccā kulā pabbajitoti vā mahākulā pabbajitoti vā, mahābhogakulā pabbajitoti vā uḷārabhogakulā pabbajitoti vā, ñāto yasassī gahaṭṭhapabbajitānanti vā,
segments.mnd10:21.6: lābhimhi cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānanti vā, suttantikoti vā vinayadharoti vā dhammakathikoti vā, āraññikoti vā piṇḍapātikoti vā paṃsukūlikoti vā tecīvarikoti vā, sapadānacārikoti vā khalupacchābhattikoti vā nesajjikoti vā yathāsanthatikoti vā,
segments.mnd10:21.7: paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhīti vā dutiyassa jhānassa lābhīti vā tatiyassa jhānassa lābhīti vā catutthassa jhānassa lābhīti vā, ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā …
segments.mnd10:21.11: Evaṃ na katthati na vikatthati, katthanā vikatthanā ārato virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatīti –
segments.mnd10:22.2: Kukkuccanti hatthakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ, pādakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ, hatthapādakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ, akappiye kappiyasaññitā kappiye akappiyasaññitā, vikāle kālasaññitā kāle vikālasaññitā, avajje vajjasaññitā vajje avajjasaññitā;
segments.mnd10:22.3: yaṃ evarūpaṃ kukkuccaṃ kukkuccāyanā kukkuccāyitattaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho –
segments.mnd10:23.1: Api ca dvīhi kāraṇehi uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho katattā ca akatattā ca.
segments.mnd10:23.2: Kathaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho?
segments.mnd10:23.3: “Kataṃ me kāyaduccaritaṃ, akataṃ me kāyasucaritan” tiuppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho;
segments.mnd10:23.5: kataṃ me manoduccaritaṃ, akataṃ me manosucaritan”ti –
segments.mnd10:23.7: “kato me pāṇātipāto, akatā me pāṇātipātā veramaṇī”ti –
segments.mnd10:23.9: “kataṃ me adinnādānaṃ, akatā me adinnādānā veramaṇī”ti –
segments.mnd10:23.11: “kato me kāmesumicchācāro, akatā me kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī”ti –
segments.mnd10:23.13: “kato me musāvādo, akatā me musāvādā veramaṇī”ti …
segments.mnd10:23.14: “katā me pisuṇā vācā, akatā me pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī”ti …
segments.mnd10:23.15: “katā me pharusā vācā, akatā me pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī”ti …
segments.mnd10:23.16: “kato me samphappalāpo, akatā me samphappalāpā veramaṇī”ti …
segments.mnd10:23.21: Evaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.mnd10:24.19: Yassetaṃ kukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ samucchinnaṃ vūpasantaṃ paṭipassaddhaṃ abhabbuppattikaṃ ñāṇagginā daḍḍhaṃ, so vuccati akukkuccoti –
segments.mnd10:25.3: Yā paññā pajānanā … pe … amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi.
segments.mnd10:25.4: Mantāya pariggahetvā pariggahetvā vācaṃ bhāsati bahumpi kathento bahumpi bhaṇanto bahumpi dīpayanto bahumpi voharanto.
segments.mnd10:25.5: Dukkathitaṃ dubbhaṇitaṃ dullapitaṃ duruttaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ vācaṃ na bhāsatīti –
segments.mnd10:25.9: Yaṃ cittassa uddhaccaṃ avūpasamo cetaso vikkhepo bhantattaṃ cittassa –
segments.mnd10:25.11: Yassetaṃ uddhaccaṃ pahīnaṃ samucchinnaṃ vūpasantaṃ paṭipassaddhaṃ abhabbuppattikaṃ ñāṇagginā daḍḍhaṃ, so vuccati anuddhatoti –
segments.mnd10:26.2: Idha bhikkhu musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
segments.mnd10:26.3: Pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti –
segments.mnd10:26.4: ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya.
segments.mnd10:26.5: Iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā, sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā, samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mnd10:26.6: Pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti –
segments.mnd10:26.7: yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mnd10:26.9: kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
segments.mnd10:26.10: Catūhi vacīsucaritehi samannāgato catuddosāpagataṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, bāttiṃsāya tiracchānakathāya ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati.
segments.mnd10:27.19: Vācāyatoti yatto pariyatto gutto gopito rakkhito vūpasanto.
segments.mnd10:27.22: Yā paññā pajānanā … pe … amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi … pe …
segments.mnd10:31.3: Yo rāgo sārāgo … pe … abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.mnd10:31.4: Yassesā āsatti taṇhā pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭipassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāti.
segments.mnd10:31.6: Atha vā “evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānan”ti tattha nandiṃ na samannāneti,
segments.mnd10:31.10: evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānan”ti tattha nandiṃ na samannāneti.
segments.mnd10:31.12: Atha vā “iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatamaddhānaṃ –
segments.mnd10:31.13: iti rūpā”ti appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ na paṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānappaccayā na tadabhinandati;
segments.mnd10:31.19: iti dhammā”ti appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ na paṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānappaccayā na tadabhinandati;
segments.mnd10:31.22: Atha vā “imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā”ti appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ na paṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānappaccayā na tadabhinandati;
segments.mnd10:32.2: Vipariṇataṃ vā vatthuṃ na socati, vipariṇatasmiṃ vā vatthusmiṃ na socati,“cakkhu me vipariṇatan”ti na socati,
segments.mnd10:32.32: sālohitā me vipariṇatā”ti na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjatīti –
segments.mnd10:33.2: Cakkhusamphasso sotasamphasso ghānasamphasso jivhāsamphasso kāyasamphasso manosamphasso, adhivacanasamphasso paṭighasamphasso, sukhavedanīyo phasso dukkhavedanīyo phasso adukkhamasukhavedanīyo phasso, kusalo phasso akusalo phasso abyākato phasso, kāmāvacaro phasso rūpāvacaro phasso arūpāvacaro phasso, suññato phasso animitto phasso appaṇihito phasso, lokiyo phasso lokuttaro phasso, atīto phasso anāgato phasso paccuppanno phasso;
segments.mnd10:33.3: yo evarūpo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ –
segments.mnd10:34.2: Cakkhusamphassaṃ vivittaṃ passati attena vā attaniyena vā niccena vā dhuvena vā sassatena vā avipariṇāmadhammena vā,
segments.mnd10:34.19: lokiyaṃ phassaṃ vivittaṃ passati attena vā attaniyena vā niccena vā dhuvena vā sassatena vā avipariṇāmadhammena vā.
segments.mnd10:35.1: Atha vā atītaṃ phassaṃ anāgatehi ca paccuppannehi ca phassehi vivittaṃ passati, anāgataṃ phassaṃ atītehi ca paccuppannehi ca phassehi vivittaṃ passati, paccuppannaṃ phassaṃ atītehi ca anāgatehi ca phassehi vivittaṃ passati.
segments.mnd10:35.2: Atha vā ye te phassā ariyā anāsavā lokuttarā suññatapaṭisaññuttā, te phasse vivitte passati rāgena dosena mohena kodhena upanāhena makkhena paḷāsena issāya macchariyena māyāya sāṭheyyena thambhena sārambhena mānena atimānena madena pamādena sabbakilesehi sabbaduccaritehi sabbadarathehi sabbapariḷāhehi sabbasantāpehi sabbākusalābhisaṅkhārehi vivitte passatīti –
segments.mnd10:36.2: Tassa dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni.
segments.mnd10:36.3: So diṭṭhiyā na yāyati na nīyati na vuyhati na saṃharīyati;
segments.mnd10:36.4: napi taṃ diṭṭhigataṃ sārato pacceti na paccāgacchatīti –
segments.mnd10:40.2: Patilīnoti rāgassa pahīnattā patilīno, dosassa pahīnattā patilīno, mohassa pahīnattā patilīno, kodhassa … upanāhassa … makkhassa … paḷāsassa … issāya … macchariyassa … pe …
segments.mnd10:40.6: Imassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno asmimāno pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
segments.mnd10:40.7: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu patilīno hotī”ti –
segments.mnd10:41.2: paccayapaṭisevanasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu, iriyāpathasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu, sāmantajappanasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu.
segments.mnd10:42.3: So pāpiccho icchāpakato atthiko cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya cīvaraṃ paccakkhāti, piṇḍapātaṃ paccakkhāti, senāsanaṃ paccakkhāti, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paccakkhāti.
segments.mnd10:42.6: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo susānā vā saṅkārakūṭā vā pāpaṇikā vā nantakāni uccinitvā saṅghāṭiṃ katvā dhāreyya.
segments.mnd10:42.8: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo uñchācariyāya piṇḍiyālopena jīvikaṃ kappeyya.
segments.mnd10:42.10: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo rukkhamūliko vā assa sosāniko vā abbhokāsiko vā.
segments.mnd10:42.12: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo pūtimuttena vā haritakīkhaṇḍena vā osadhaṃ kareyyā”ti.
segments.mnd10:42.13: Tadupādāya lūkhaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāreti, lūkhaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjati, lūkhaṃ senāsanaṃ paṭisevati, lūkhaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paṭisevati.
segments.mnd10:42.15: “ayaṃ samaṇo appiccho santuṭṭho pavivitto asaṃsaṭṭho āraddhavīriyo dhutavādo”ti bhiyyo bhiyyo nimantenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi.
segments.mnd10:42.17: “tiṇṇaṃ sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati.
segments.mnd10:42.18: Saddhāya sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati, deyyadhammassa sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati, dakkhiṇeyyānaṃ sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati.
segments.mnd10:42.19: ‘Tumhākañcevāyaṃ saddhā atthi, deyyadhammo ca saṃvijjati, ahañca paṭiggāhako.
segments.mnd10:42.20: Sacehaṃ na paṭiggahessāmi, evaṃ tumhe puññena paribāhirā bhavissanti.
segments.mnd10:42.23: Tadupādāya bahumpi cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, bahumpi piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, bahumpi gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti.
segments.mnd10:42.24: Yā evarūpā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ –
segments.mnd10:43.2: Idhekacco pāpiccho icchāpakato sambhāvanādhippāyo,“evaṃ maṃ jano sambhāvessatī”ti, gamanaṃ saṇṭhapeti ṭhānaṃ saṇṭhapeti nisajjaṃ saṇṭhapeti sayanaṃ saṇṭhapeti, paṇidhāya gacchati paṇidhāya tiṭṭhati paṇidhāya nisīdati paṇidhāya seyyaṃ kappeti, samāhito viya gacchati samāhito viya tiṭṭhati samāhito viya nisīdati samāhito viya seyyaṃ kappeti, āpāthakajjhāyīva hoti.
segments.mnd10:43.3: Yā evarūpā iriyāpathassa ṭhapanā āṭhapanā [aṭṭhapanā (sī.)] saṇṭhapanā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ –
segments.mnd10:44.2: Idhekacco pāpiccho icchāpakato sambhāvanādhippāyo,“evaṃ maṃ jano sambhāvessatī”ti, ariyadhammasannissitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati.
segments.mnd10:44.3: “Yo evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāreti so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati;
segments.mnd10:44.11: āyogaṃ dhāreti so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati;
segments.mnd10:44.12: “yassa evarūpo upajjhāyo so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati;
segments.mnd10:44.20: “yo evarūpe vihāre vasati so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati;
segments.mnd10:44.33: rukkhamūle vasati, so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati.
segments.mnd10:45.1: Atha vā korajikakorajiko [korañjikakorañjiko (sī.)] bhākuṭikabhākuṭiko kuhakakuhako lapakalapako mukhasambhāviko,“ayaṃ samaṇo imāsaṃ evarūpānaṃ santānaṃ vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī”ti tādisaṃ gambhīraṃ gūḷhaṃ nipuṇaṃ paṭicchannaṃ lokuttaraṃ suññatāpaṭisaṃyuttaṃ kathaṃ kathesi.
segments.mnd10:45.2: Yā evarūpā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ –
segments.mnd10:45.4: Yassimāni tīṇi kuhanavatthūni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni, so vuccati akuhakoti –
segments.mnd10:46.3: Yo rāgo sārāgo … pe … abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.mnd10:46.4: Yassesā pihā taṇhā pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭipassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhā, so vuccati apihālu.
segments.mnd10:46.5: So rūpe na piheti, sadde … gandhe … rase … phoṭṭhabbe … kulaṃ … gaṇaṃ … āvāsaṃ … lābhaṃ … yasaṃ … pasaṃsaṃ … sukhaṃ … cīvaraṃ … piṇḍapātaṃ … senāsanaṃ … gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ … kāmadhātuṃ … rūpadhātuṃ … arūpadhātuṃ … kāmabhavaṃ … rūpabhavaṃ … arūpabhavaṃ … saññābhavaṃ … asaññābhavaṃ … nevasaññānāsaññābhavaṃ … ekavokārabhavaṃ … catuvokārabhavaṃ … pañcavokārabhavaṃ … atītaṃ … anāgataṃ … paccuppannaṃ … diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbe dhamme na piheti na icchati na sādiyati na pattheti nābhijappatīti –
segments.mnd10:46.9: Yaṃ evarūpaṃ maccharaṃ maccharāyanā maccharāyitattaṃ vevicchaṃ kadariyaṃ kaṭukañcukatā aggahitattaṃ cittassa –
segments.mnd10:46.11: Api ca khandhamacchariyampi macchariyaṃ, dhātumacchariyampi macchariyaṃ, āyatanamacchariyampi macchariyaṃ gāho –
segments.mnd10:46.13: Yassetaṃ macchariyaṃ pahīnaṃ samucchinnaṃ vūpasantaṃ paṭipassaddhaṃ abhabbuppattikaṃ ñāṇagginā daḍḍhaṃ, so vuccati amaccharīti –
segments.mnd10:47.3: kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ, vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ, cetasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ.
segments.mnd10:47.5: Idhekacco saṅghagatopi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, gaṇagatopi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, bhojanasālāyampi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, jantāgharepi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, udakatitthepi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, antaragharaṃ pavisantopi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhopi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti.
segments.mnd10:48.2: Idhekacco saṅghagato acittīkārakato [acittikārakato (syā. ka.)] there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayantopi tiṭṭhati, ghaṭṭayantopi nisīdati, puratopi tiṭṭhati, puratopi nisīdati, uccepi āsane nisīdati, sasīsaṃ pārupitvāpi nisīdati, ṭhitakopi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepakopi bhaṇati.
segments.mnd10:49.2: Idhekacco gaṇagato acittīkārakato therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupāhanānaṃ caṅkamantānaṃ saupāhano caṅkamati, nīce caṅkame caṅkamantānaṃ ucce caṅkame caṅkamati, chamāya caṅkamantānaṃ caṅkame caṅkamati, ghaṭṭayantopi tiṭṭhati, ghaṭṭayantopi nisīdati, puratopi tiṭṭhati, puratopi nisīdati, uccepi āsane nisīdati, sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisīdati, ṭhitakopi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepakopi bhaṇati.
segments.mnd10:50.2: Idhekacco bhojanasālāyaṃ acittīkārakato there bhikkhū anupakhajja nisīdati, navepi bhikkhū āsanena paṭibāhati, ghaṭṭayantopi tiṭṭhati, ghaṭṭayantopi nisīdati, puratopi tiṭṭhati, puratopi nisīdati, uccepi āsane nisīdati, sasīsaṃ pārupitvāpi nisīdati, ṭhitakopi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepakopi bhaṇati.
segments.mnd10:51.2: Idhekacco jantāghare acittīkārakato there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayantopi tiṭṭhati, ghaṭṭayantopi nisīdati, puratopi tiṭṭhati, puratopi nisīdati, uccepi āsane nisīdati, anāpucchampi anajjhiṭṭhopi kaṭṭhaṃ pakkhipati, dvārampi pidahati, bāhāvikkhepakopi bhaṇati.
segments.mnd10:52.2: Idhekacco udakatitthe acittīkārakato there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayantopi otarati, puratopi otarati, ghaṭṭayantopi nhāyati [nahāyati (sī.)], puratopi nhāyati, uparitopi nhāyati, ghaṭṭayantopi uttarati, puratopi uttarati, uparitopi uttarati.
segments.mnd10:53.1: Kathaṃ antaragharaṃ pavisanto kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti?
segments.mnd10:53.2: Idhekacco antaragharaṃ pavisanto acittīkārakato there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayantopi gacchati, puratopi gacchati, vokkammāpi therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ purato purato gacchati.
segments.mnd10:53.3: Evaṃ antaragharaṃ pavisanto kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti.
segments.mnd10:54.1: Kathaṃ antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti?
segments.mnd10:54.2: Idhekacco antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho,“na pavisa [pavisatha (sī.) evamaññesu padadvayesupi], bhante”ti vuccamāno pavisati,“na tiṭṭha, bhante”ti vuccamāno tiṭṭhati,“na nisīda, bhante”ti vuccamāno nisīdati, anokāsampi pavisati, anokāsepi tiṭṭhati, anokāsepi nisīdati, yānipi tāni honti kulānaṃ ovarakāni gūḷhāni ca paṭicchannāni ca.
segments.mnd10:54.3: Yattha kulitthiyo kuladhītaro kulasuṇhāyo kulakumāriyo nisīdanti, tatthapi sahasā pavisati kumārakassapi siraṃ parāmasati.
segments.mnd10:54.4: Evaṃ antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti –
segments.mnd10:55.2: Idhekacco saṅghagatopi vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, gaṇagatopi vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhopi vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti.
segments.mnd10:56.2: Idhekacco saṅghagato acittīkārakato there bhikkhū anāpucchaṃ vā anajjhiṭṭho vā ārāmagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇati, pañhaṃ visajjeti, pātimokkhaṃ uddisati, ṭhitakopi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepakopi bhaṇati.
segments.mnd10:57.2: Idhekacco gaṇagato acittīkārakato there bhikkhū anāpucchaṃ vā anajjhiṭṭho vā ārāmagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇati, pañhaṃ visajjeti, ṭhitakopi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepakopi bhaṇati.
segments.mnd10:57.3: Ārāmagatānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇati, pañhaṃ visajjeti, ṭhitakopi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepakopi bhaṇati.
segments.mnd10:58.1: Kathaṃ antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti?
segments.mnd10:58.2: Idhekacco antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho itthiṃ vā kumāriṃ vā evamāha –
segments.mnd10:58.4: Yāgu atthi, bhattaṃ atthi, khādanīyaṃ atthi.
segments.mnd10:58.5: Kiṃ pivissāma, kiṃ bhuñjissāma, kiṃ khādissāma?
segments.mnd10:58.6: Kiṃ vā atthi, kiṃ vā me dassathā”ti vippalapati, yā evarūpā vācā palāpo vippalāpo lālappo lālappanā lālappitattaṃ.
segments.mnd10:58.7: Evaṃ antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti –
segments.mnd10:59.2: Idhekacco na uccā kulā pabbajito samāno uccā kulā pabbajitena saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ dahati cittena, na mahākulā pabbajito samāno mahākulā pabbajitena saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ dahati cittena, na mahābhogakulā pabbajito samāno mahābhogakulā pabbajitena saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ dahati cittena, na uḷārabhogakulā pabbajito samāno … na suttantiko samāno suttantikena saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ dahati cittena, na vinayadharo samāno … na dhammakathiko samāno … na āraññiko samāno … na piṇḍapātiko samāno … na paṃsukūliko samāno … na tecīvariko samāno … na sapadānacāriko samāno … na khalupacchābhattiko samāno … na nesajjiko samāno … na yathāsanthatiko samāno … na paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhī samāno paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhinā saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ dahati cittena … pe …
segments.mnd10:59.3: na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī samāno nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhinā saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ dahati cittena –
segments.mnd10:59.5: Yassimāni tīṇi pāgabbhiyāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni, so vuccati appagabbhoti –
segments.mnd10:60.4: Idhekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asucisaṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto –
segments.mnd10:60.6: Atha vā kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patiṭṭhīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti –
segments.mnd10:60.8: Atha vā kodhano hoti upanāhī, makkhī hoti paḷāsī, issukī hoti maccharī, saṭho hoti māyāvī, thaddho hoti atimānī, pāpiccho hoti micchādiṭṭhi [micchādiṭṭhī (sī.)], sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī –
segments.mnd10:61.2: Idha bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu –
segments.mnd10:61.4: Atha vā akkodhano hoti anupāyāsabahulo, bahumpi vutto samāno na abhisajjati na kuppati na byāpajjati na patiṭṭhīyati, na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti –
segments.mnd10:61.6: Atha vā akkodhano hoti anupanāhī, amakkhī hoti apaḷāsī, anissukī hoti amaccharī, asaṭho hoti amāyāvī, athaddho hoti anatimānī, na pāpiccho hoti na micchādiṭṭhi, asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti anādānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī –
segments.mnd10:61.8: Sabbe bālaputhujjanā jegucchā, puthujjanakalyāṇakaṃ upādāya aṭṭha ariyapuggalā ajegucchāti –
segments.mnd10:62.2: Pesuññanti idhekacco pisuṇavāco hoti, ito sutvā amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya.
segments.mnd10:62.3: Iti samaggānaṃ vā bhettā [bhedo (ka.)], bhinnānaṃ vā anuppadātā, vaggārāmo, vaggarato, vagganandī, vaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti –
segments.mnd10:63.1: Api ca dvīhi kāraṇehi pesuññaṃ upasaṃharati –
segments.mnd10:63.4: Imassa piyo bhavissāmi, manāpo bhavissāmi, vissāsiko bhavissāmi, abbhantariko bhavissāmi, suhadayo bhavissāmīti.
segments.mnd10:63.7: “Kathaṃ ime nānā assu vinā assu vaggā assu dvedhā assu dvejjhā assu dve pakkhā assu bhijjeyyuṃ na samāgaccheyyuṃ dukkhaṃ na phāsu [aphāsuṃ (sī.)] vihareyyun”ti.
segments.mnd10:63.9: Yassetaṃ pesuññaṃ pahīnaṃ samucchinnaṃ vūpasantaṃ paṭipassaddhaṃ abhabbuppattikaṃ ñāṇagginā daḍḍhaṃ, so pesuññe no yuto na yutto na payutto na sammāyuttoti –
segments.mnd10:67.4: Yebhuyyena devamanussā pañca kāmaguṇe icchanti sātiyanti patthayanti pihayanti abhijappanti, taṃkāraṇā sātiyā vuccanti pañca kāmaguṇā.
segments.mnd10:67.5: Yesaṃ esā sātiyā taṇhā appahīnā tesaṃ cakkhuto rūpataṇhā savati āsavati [pasavati (syā.)] sandati pavattati, sotato saddataṇhā … ghānato gandhataṇhā … jivhāto rasataṇhā … kāyato phoṭṭhabbataṇhā … manato dhammataṇhā savati āsavati sandati pavattati.
segments.mnd10:67.6: Yesaṃ esā sātiyā taṇhā pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭipassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhā tesaṃ cakkhuto rūpataṇhā na savati nāsavati [na pasavati (syā.)] na sandati na pavattati, sotato saddataṇhā … pe …
segments.mnd10:67.7: manato dhammataṇhā na savati nāsavati na sandati na pavattatīti –
segments.mnd10:68.3: Idhekacco paraṃ atimaññati jātiyā vā gottena vā … pe … aññataraññatarena vā vatthunā.
segments.mnd10:68.4: Yo evarūpo māno maññanā maññitattaṃ unnati unnamo dhajo sampaggāho ketukamyatā cittassa –
segments.mnd10:68.6: Yasseso atimāno pahīno samucchinno vūpasanto paṭipassaddho abhabbuppattiko ñāṇagginā daḍḍho, so atimāne ca no yuto na yutto nappayutto na sammāyuttoti –
segments.mnd10:69.2: Saṇhoti saṇhena kāyakammena samannāgatoti saṇho, saṇhena vacīkammena … saṇhena manokammena samannāgatoti saṇho, saṇhehi satipaṭṭhānehi samannāgatoti saṇho, saṇhehi sammappadhānehi … saṇhehi iddhipādehi … saṇhehi indriyehi … saṇhehi balehi … saṇhehi bojjhaṅgehi samannāgatoti saṇho, saṇhena ariyena aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena samannāgatoti –
segments.mnd10:70.5: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ, tassa pariyattiṃ nissāya paṭibhāyati –
segments.mnd10:70.8: Idhekacco paripucchitā [paripucchitaṃ (sī.), paripucchako (syā.)] hoti attatthe ca ñāyatthe ca lakkhaṇe ca kāraṇe ca ṭhānāṭhāne ca, tassa taṃ paripucchaṃ nissāya paṭibhāyati –
segments.mnd10:70.11: Idhekaccassa adhigatā honti cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañcindriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo cattāro ariyamaggā cattāri sāmaññaphalāni catasso paṭisambhidāyo cha abhiññāyo,
segments.mnd10:70.12: tassa attho ñāto dhammo ñāto nirutti ñātā,
segments.mnd10:70.17: Imāya paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāya upeto samupeto upagato samupagato upapanno samupapanno samannāgato so vuccati paṭibhānavā.
segments.mnd10:70.18: Yassa pariyatti natthi, paripucchā natthi, adhigamo natthi, kiṃ tassa paṭibhāyissatīti –
segments.mnd10:71.2: Na saddhoti sāmaṃ sayaṃ abhiññātaṃ attapaccakkhaṃ dhammaṃ na kassaci saddahati aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā devassa vā mārassa vā brahmuno vā.
segments.mnd10:71.3: “Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti sāmaṃ sayaṃ abhiññātaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd10:71.15: “ime dhammā sacchikātabbā”ti sāmaṃ sayaṃ abhiññātaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd10:71.16: channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca, pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca … pe …
segments.mnd10:71.17: catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca sāmaṃ sayaṃ abhiññātaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd10:71.18: “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman”ti sāmaṃ sayaṃ abhiññātaṃ attapaccakkhaṃ dhammaṃ na kassaci saddahati aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā devassa vā mārassa vā brahmuno vā [brahmuno vā … pe …(sī. ka.)].
segments.mnd10:72.2: “saddahasi tvaṃ, sāriputta, saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ;
segments.mnd10:72.6: paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānan”ti?
segments.mnd10:73.1: “Na khvāhaṃ ettha, bhante, bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi saddhindriyaṃ …
segments.mnd10:73.5: paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
segments.mnd10:73.6: Yesaṃ nūnetaṃ, bhante, aññātaṃ assa adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ paññāya, te tattha paresaṃ saddhāya gaccheyyuṃ saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
segments.mnd10:73.10: paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
segments.mnd10:73.11: Yesañca kho etaṃ, bhante, ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya, nikkaṅkhā te tattha nibbicikicchā.
segments.mnd10:73.16: paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
segments.mnd10:73.17: Mayhañca kho, etaṃ bhante, ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya, nikkaṅkhohaṃ tattha nibbicikiccho.
segments.mnd10:73.22: paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānan”ti.
segments.mnd10:74.2: Yesañhetaṃ, sāriputta, aññātaṃ assa adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ paññāya, te tattha paresaṃ saddhāya gaccheyyuṃ saddhindriyaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd10:74.3: paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānanti.
segments.mnd10:76.2: Sabbe bālaputhujjanā rajjanti, puthujjanakalyāṇakaṃ upādāya satta sekkhā virajjanti.
segments.mnd10:76.3: Arahā neva rajjati no virajjati, viratto so khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā khayā dosassa vītadosattā, khayā mohassa vītamohattā.
segments.mnd10:76.4: So vuṭṭhavāso ciṇṇacaraṇo … pe … jātimaraṇasaṃsāro natthi tassa punabbhavoti –
segments.mnd10:80.1: Lābhakamyā na sikkhati, alābhe ca na kuppatīti.
segments.mnd10:80.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
segments.mnd10:80.8: So lābhahetu lābhapaccayā lābhakāraṇā lābhābhinibbattiyā lābhaṃ paripācento suttantaṃ pariyāpuṇāti.
segments.mnd10:81.1: Atha vā bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
segments.mnd10:81.8: So lābhahetu lābhapaccayā lābhakāraṇā lābhābhinibbattiyā lābhaṃ paripācento abhidhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti.
segments.mnd10:82.1: Atha vā bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
segments.mnd10:82.13: So lābhahetu lābhapaccayā lābhakāraṇā lābhābhinibbattiyā lābhaṃ paripācento āraññiko hoti … pe …
segments.mnd10:83.2: Idha bhikkhu na lābhahetu, na lābhapaccayā, na lābhakāraṇā, na lābhābhinibbattiyā, na lābhaṃ paripācento, yāvadeva attadamatthāya attasamatthāya attaparinibbāpanatthāya suttantaṃ pariyāpuṇāti, vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇāti, abhidhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti.
segments.mnd10:84.1: Atha vā bhikkhu na lābhahetu, na lābhapaccayā, na lābhakāraṇā, na lābhābhinibbattiyā, na lābhaṃ paripācento, yāvadeva appicchaññeva [appicchaṃyeva (sī.)] nissāya santuṭṭhiññeva nissāya sallekhaññeva nissāya pavivekaññeva nissāya idamatthitaññeva [idamatthikataññeva (sī.)] nissāya āraññiko hoti, piṇḍapātiko hoti, paṃsukūliko hoti, tecīvariko hoti, sapadānacāriko hoti, khalupacchābhattiko hoti, nesajjiko hoti, yathāsanthatiko hoti.
segments.mnd10:85.3: Idhekacco “kulaṃ vā na labhāmi, gaṇaṃ vā na labhāmi, āvāsaṃ vā na labhāmi, lābhaṃ vā na labhāmi, yasaṃ vā na labhāmi, pasaṃsaṃ vā na labhāmi, sukhaṃ vā na labhāmi, cīvaraṃ vā na labhāmi, piṇḍapātaṃ vā na labhāmi, senāsanaṃ vā na labhāmi, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ vā na labhāmi, gilānupaṭṭhākaṃ vā na labhāmi, appaññātomhī”ti kuppati byāpajjati patiṭṭhīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
segments.mnd10:86.2: Idha bhikkhu “kulaṃ vā na labhāmi gaṇaṃ vā na labhāmi … pe …
segments.mnd10:86.3: appaññātomhī”ti na kuppati na byāpajjati na patiṭṭhīyati, na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
segments.mnd10:86.5: lābhakamyā na sikkhati alābhe ca na kuppati.
segments.mnd10:87.2: Viruddhoti yo cittassa āghāto paṭighāto, paṭighaṃ paṭivirodho, kopo pakopo sampakopo, doso padoso sampadoso, cittassa byāpatti manopadoso, kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ, doso dussanā dussitattaṃ, byāpatti byāpajjanā byāpajjitattaṃ virodho paṭivirodho, caṇḍikkaṃ, asuropo, anattamanatā cittassa –
segments.mnd10:87.4: Yasseso virodho pahīno samucchinno vūpasanto paṭipassaddho abhabbuppattiko ñāṇagginā daḍḍho, so vuccati aviruddho.
segments.mnd10:87.5: Taṇhāti rūpataṇhā saddataṇhā gandhataṇhā rasataṇhā phoṭṭhabbataṇhā dhammataṇhā.
segments.mnd10:87.6: Rasoti mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso, ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambikaṃ [lapilaṃ (sī.), lambilaṃ (syā.), labilaṃ (ka.), āyatanavibhaṅge] kasāvo sādu asādu sītaṃ uṇhaṃ.
segments.mnd10:87.8: Te jivhaggena rasaggāni pariyesantā āhiṇḍanti, te ambilaṃ labhitvā anambilaṃ pariyesanti, anambilaṃ labhitvā ambilaṃ pariyesanti;
segments.mnd10:87.9: madhuraṃ labhitvā amadhuraṃ pariyesanti, amadhuraṃ labhitvā madhuraṃ pariyesanti;
segments.mnd10:87.10: tittakaṃ labhitvā atittakaṃ pariyesanti, atittakaṃ labhitvā tittakaṃ pariyesanti;
segments.mnd10:87.11: kaṭukaṃ labhitvā akaṭukaṃ pariyesanti, akaṭukaṃ labhitvā kaṭukaṃ pariyesanti;
segments.mnd10:87.12: loṇikaṃ labhitvā aloṇikaṃ pariyesanti, aloṇikaṃ labhitvā loṇikaṃ pariyesanti;
segments.mnd10:87.13: khārikaṃ labhitvā akhārikaṃ pariyesanti, akhārikaṃ labhitvā khārikaṃ pariyesanti;
segments.mnd10:87.14: lambikaṃ labhitvā kasāvaṃ pariyesanti, kasāvaṃ labhitvā lambikaṃ pariyesanti;
segments.mnd10:87.15: sāduṃ labhitvā asāduṃ pariyesanti, asāduṃ labhitvā sāduṃ pariyesanti;
segments.mnd10:87.16: sītaṃ labhitvā uṇhaṃ pariyesanti, uṇhaṃ labhitvā sītaṃ pariyesanti.
segments.mnd10:87.17: Te yaṃ yaṃ labhitvā tena tena na santussanti aparāparaṃ pariyesanti, manāpikesu rasesu rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhosannā laggā laggitā palibuddhā.
segments.mnd10:87.18: Yassesā rasataṇhā pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭipassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhā, so paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti –
segments.mnd10:87.19: “neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya.
segments.mnd10:87.20: Iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā”ti.
segments.mnd10:88.1: Yathā vanaṃ ālimpeyya yāvadeva ropanatthāya, yathā vā pana akkhaṃ abbhañjeyya yāvadeva bhārassa nittharaṇatthāya, yathā vā pana puttamaṃsaṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya yāvadeva kantārassa nittharaṇatthāya;
segments.mnd10:88.2: evameva bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti –
segments.mnd10:88.4: Rasataṇhaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantiṃ karoti anabhāvaṃ gameti, rasataṇhāya ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatīti –
segments.mnd10:92.3: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
segments.mnd10:92.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
segments.mnd10:92.6: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā manāpaṃ nābhigijjhati nābhihaṃsati [nābhihasati (sī. syā.)] na rāgaṃ janeti, tassa ṭhitova kāyo hoti, ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
segments.mnd10:92.7: Cakkhunā kho paneva rūpaṃ disvā amanāpaṃ na maṅku hoti appatiṭṭhitacitto [appatiṭṭhīna citto (syā.), appatiṭṭhanacitto (ka.)] alīnamanaso [ādinamanaso (syā.)] abyāpannacetaso, tassa ṭhitova kāyo hoti, ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
segments.mnd10:92.12: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya manāpaṃ nābhigijjhati nābhihaṃsati na rāgaṃ janeti, tassa ṭhitova kāyo hoti, ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
segments.mnd10:92.13: Manasā kho paneva dhammaṃ viññāya amanāpaṃ na maṅku hoti appatiṭṭhitacitto alīnamanaso abyāpannacetaso, tassa ṭhitova kāyo hoti, ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
segments.mnd10:93.1: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā manāpāmanāpesu rūpesu tassa ṭhitova kāyo hoti, ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
segments.mnd10:93.3: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya manāpāmanāpesu dhammesu tassa ṭhitova kāyo hoti, ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
segments.mnd10:94.1: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rajanīye na rajjati, dussanīye [dosanīye (bahūsu)] na dussati, mohanīye na muyhati, kopanīye na kuppati, madanīye na majjati, kilesanīye na kilissati.
segments.mnd10:94.3: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya rajanīye na rajjati dussanīye na dussati, mohanīye na muyhati, kopanīye na kuppati, madanīye na majjati, kilesanīye na kilissati.
segments.mnd10:94.4: Diṭṭhe diṭṭhamatto, sute sutamatto, mute mutamatto, viññāte viññātamatto.
segments.mnd10:94.5: Diṭṭhe na limpati, sute na limpati, mute na limpati, viññāte na limpati.
segments.mnd10:94.6: Diṭṭhe anūpayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati.
segments.mnd10:94.9: viññāte anūpayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati.
segments.mnd10:95.1: Saṃvijjati arahato cakkhu, passati arahā cakkhunā rūpaṃ.
segments.mnd10:95.3: Saṃvijjati arahato sotaṃ, suṇāti arahā sotena saddaṃ.
segments.mnd10:95.5: Saṃvijjati arahato ghānaṃ, ghāyati arahā ghānena gandhaṃ.
segments.mnd10:95.7: Saṃvijjati arahato jivhā, sāyati arahā jivhāya rasaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd10:95.8: saṃvijjati arahato kāyo, phusati arahā kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd10:95.9: saṃvijjati arahato mano, vijānāti arahā manasā dhammaṃ.
segments.mnd10:96.1: Cakkhu rūpārāmaṃ rūparataṃ rūpasammuditaṃ, taṃ arahato dantaṃ guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ saṃvutaṃ, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.
segments.mnd10:96.4: jivhā rasārāmā rasaratā rasasammuditā, sā arahato dantā guttā rakkhitā saṃvutā, tassā ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.
segments.mnd10:96.6: mano dhammārāmo dhammarato dhammasammudito, so arahato danto gutto rakkhito saṃvuto, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.
segments.mnd10:101.2: ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca [ajjhattabahiddhā ca (sī.), ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca (syā. ka.) su. ni.521] sabbaloke;
segments.mnd10:101.3: Nibbijjha imaṃ [nibbijjhimaṃ (syā.), nibbijja imaṃ (ka.)] parañca lokaṃ,
segments.mnd10:102.2: Sadā sabbadā sabbakālaṃ niccakālaṃ dhuvakālaṃ … pe …
segments.mnd10:103.2: “Sadisohamasmī”ti mānaṃ na janeti jātiyā vā gottena vā … pe … aññataraññatarena vā vatthunāti –

segments.mnd10:110.2: Ñatvāti ñatvā jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā,“sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti ñatvā jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā,

segments.mnd10:116.6: Vatthukāme parijānitvā, kilesakāme pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā kāmesu anapekkhino vītakāmo cattakāmo vantakāmo muttakāmo pahīnakāmo paṭinissaṭṭhakāmo, kāmesu vītarāgo vigatarāgo cattarāgo vantarāgo muttarāgo pahīnarāgo paṭinissaṭṭharāgo nicchāto nibbuto sītibhūto sukhappaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharatīti –

segments.mnd10:117.7: Ganthā tassa natthi na santi na saṃvijjanti nupalabbhanti, pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭipassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāti –

segments.mnd10:127.2: Puthujjanāti puthu kilese janentīti puthujjanā, puthu avihatasakkāyadiṭṭhikāti puthujjanā, puthu satthārānaṃ mukhullokikāti [mukhullokakāti (sī.)] puthujjanā, puthu sabbagatīhi avuṭṭhitāti puthujjanā, puthu nānābhisaṅkhāre abhisaṅkharontīti puthujjanā, puthu nānāoghehi vuyhantīti puthujjanā, puthu nānāsantāpehi santappentīti puthujjanā, puthu nānāpariḷāhehi pariḍayhantīti puthujjanā, puthu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhosannā laggā laggitā palibuddhāti puthujjanā, puthu pañcahi nīvaraṇehi āvutā nivutā ovutā pihitā paṭicchannā paṭikujjitāti –
segments.mnd10:127.4: Samaṇāti ye keci ito bahiddhā paribbajūpagatā paribbajasamāpannā.
segments.mnd10:127.7: Puthujjanā yena taṃ rāgena vadeyyuṃ, yena dosena vadeyyuṃ, yena mohena vadeyyuṃ, yena mānena vadeyyuṃ, yāya diṭṭhiyā vadeyyuṃ, yena uddhaccena vadeyyuṃ, yāya vicikicchāya vadeyyuṃ, yehi anusayehi vadeyyuṃ, rattoti vā duṭṭhoti vā mūḷhoti vā vinibaddhoti vā parāmaṭṭhoti vā vikkhepagatoti vā aniṭṭhaṅgatoti vā thāmagatoti vā te abhisaṅkhārā pahīnā;
segments.mnd10:127.8: abhisaṅkhārānaṃ pahīnattā gatiyā [gatiyo (syā.)] yena taṃ vadeyyuṃ –
segments.mnd10:127.9: nerayikoti vā tiracchānayonikoti vā pettivisayikoti vā manussoti vā devoti vā rūpīti vā arūpīti vā saññīti vā asaññīti vā nevasaññīnāsaññīti vā.
segments.mnd10:127.10: So hetu natthi paccayo natthi kāraṇaṃ natthi yena naṃ vadeyyuṃ katheyyuṃ bhaṇeyyuṃ dīpayeyyuṃ vohareyyunti –
segments.mnd10:127.11: yena naṃ vajjuṃ puthujjanā, atho samaṇabrāhmaṇā.
segments.mnd10:128.8: taṇhāpurekkhārassa pahīnattā, diṭṭhipurekkhārassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā na taṇhaṃ vā diṭṭhiṃ vā purato katvā carati, na taṇhādhajo na taṇhāketu na taṇhādhipateyyo, na diṭṭhidhajo na diṭṭhiketu na diṭṭhādhipateyyo, na taṇhāya vā na diṭṭhiyā vā parivārito caratīti –
segments.mnd10:129.2: Tasmāti tasmā taṃkāraṇā taṃhetu tappaccayā taṃnidānā vādesu upavādesu nindāya garahāya akittiyā avaṇṇahārikāya nejati na iñjati na calati na vedhati nappavedhati na sampavedhatīti –
segments.mnd10:133.3: Yo rāgo sārāgo … pe … abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.mnd10:133.4: Yasseso gedho pahīno samucchinno vūpasanto paṭipassaddho abhabbuppattiko ñāṇagginā daḍḍho, so vuccati vītagedho.
segments.mnd10:133.6: diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu agiddho agadhito amucchito anajjhosito, vītagedho vigatagedho cattagedho vantagedho muttagedho pahīnagedho paṭinissaṭṭhagedho nicchāto … pe …
segments.mnd10:133.14: Yassetaṃ macchariyaṃ pahīnaṃ samucchinnaṃ vūpasantaṃ paṭipassaddhaṃ abhabbuppattikaṃ ñāṇagginā daḍḍhaṃ, so vuccati amaccharīti –
segments.mnd10:134.1: Na ussesu vadate muni, na samesu na omesūti.

segments.mnd10:134.5: na ussesu vadate muni, na samesu na omesu.
segments.mnd10:135.7: taṇhākappassa pahīnattā, diṭṭhikappassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā taṇhākappaṃ vā diṭṭhikappaṃ vā neti na upeti na upagacchati na gaṇhāti na parāmasati nābhinivisatīti –
